name: Other Prices 5
definition: Specifies the type of price and information about the price.

MarketBrokerCommission.name: Market Broker Commission
MarketBrokerCommission.definition: Market price including or excluding the broker's commission.

MarkedUp.name: Marked Up
MarkedUp.definition: In case of an order to buy, the price that the broker paid on the market plus the broker's commission.

MarkedDown.name: Marked Down
MarkedDown.definition: In case of an order to sell, the price the broker receives in the market minus the broker's commission.

NetDisclosed.name: Net Disclosed
NetDisclosed.definition: Price is net to the disclosed client.

NetUndisclosed.name: Net Undisclosed
NetUndisclosed.definition: Price is net to the client undisclosed (used in the UK market).

NotionalGross.name: Notional Gross
NotionalGross.definition: Price is notional gross (used in the UK market).

BenchmarkWeightedAverage.name: Benchmark Weighted Average
BenchmarkWeightedAverage.definition: Price is weighted average price of the benchmark prices at the time of each partial fill.

AllMarketsWeightedAverage.name: All Markets Weighted Average
AllMarketsWeightedAverage.definition: Price is weighted average price of all market executions during the completion of the order.

Benchmark.name: Benchmark
Benchmark.definition: Price is a benchmark price relating to the current partial fills (eg, last trade tick from market).

OtherPrice.name: Other Price
OtherPrice.definition: Type of price that is not defined explicitly.

IndexPrice.name: Index Price
IndexPrice.definition: Price of securities representing a particular market or a portion of it.

ReportedPrice.name: Reported Price
ReportedPrice.definition: Price used to differentiate from price on a confirmation of a marked up or marked down principal trade.

ReferencePrice.name: Reference Price
ReferencePrice.definition: Price of reference of the concerned financial instrument.
